approval_policy.note: status=not_measured is never evidence; validate_model_contract() rejects an approved strategy without every entry.

recognition.rationale: No Linux measurement host, model weights, licensed corpus or CUDA device were available. The strategy is intentionally unselected; see comparison_plan.

definitions.mixed: Unified recognition over the mixed meeting audio (mic + system), with track labels only used afterwards for attribution.
definitions.separate_merge: Per-track recognition followed by cross-track merge: duplicate-pickup dedup, then speaker clustering into stable meeting identities.

dataset_expectations: same person on mic and system tracks
multiple remote speakers on one system track

gate.description: The user-approved corpus/quality gate does not exist yet. Until it is recorded, report both strategies and lock neither.

dedup_window_ms.rationale: Playback and microphone bleed share the same utterance but arrive with capture and scheduling offset. 1200 ms covers observed chunk boundaries without merging two deliberate repeats of the same sentence, which are typically further apart. Not calibrated; Step 4 must confirm on the authorised corpus.

dedup_min_text_similarity.rationale: Require near-identical normalized transcript before treating two overlapping cross-track segments as one pickup. 0.9 tolerates ASR punctuation/spacing drift while avoiding dropping a genuinely different sentence. Not calibrated.

cluster_similarity_threshold.rationale: Cosine threshold for attaching an utterance embedding to a meeting identity. 0.75 is a conservative starting point for a single embedding model; it must be recalibrated per model and per corpus. It is NOT the existing local 0.5/0.35 voiceprint threshold.

max_identities.rationale: Design §8 caps the speaker hint at 20. The clusterer may exceed the hint only when evidence demands it; the cap is a guardrail, not a merge rule.

same_person_across_tracks.description: The same person speaks once on mic and once on system; both utterances must map to one stable meeting identity.

duplicate_pickup.description: System playback is picked up again by the microphone; exactly one utterance survives dedup and one identity remains.

two_remote_speakers.description: Two different remote people share the system track; source label must not collapse them into one identity.

claim.reason: No model selected and no weight digest measured, so compatibility cannot be claimed. Equal embedding dimension alone is rejected by design.

thresholds.note: The existing 0.5/0.35 thresholds are uncalibrated for any new model and must not be copied.

observed_probe_host.reason: The development host is macOS; the target is Linux with CUDA/ROCm. ffmpeg presence on macOS is not evidence for the Linux deployment.
